title: Florian's Blog
text:
Interactive square-root trajectories on the probability simplex. Three default trajectories are shown: the pure states e1, e2, e3 each reach the uniform distribution in two steps, with e1 and e2 merging at the same intermediate point. Click inside the triangle to trace your own starting distribution and read off its two images under the root S.

title: About
text:
I am Florian Richter, an AI Evangelist with a background in quantum information. This blog is where I write up ideas from quantum information theory at the level of detail I’d want to read myself.
For collaboration inquiries, write to florian2richter@gmail.com.

title: Florian's Blog
text:
Interactive Bloch ball, the state space of a single qubit. Click the front surface of the ball to choose a pure state, then use the Purity slider to move it inward toward the maximally mixed state at the centre. The readout shows the Bloch vector, the density matrix, and its eigenvalues.
